reviews.outcome: No serious defect found in these selected arguments. Routine exercise cases and previous-lemma dependencies are expanded for the adopted entry scopes; this is not a whole-book audit. No serious defect found in the batch passages. The new entries explicitly supply finite-empty-case bounds and omitted connective, quantifier and finite-support details; these are valid source compressions, not registered defects.
